Mediterranean Chickpea-Rice Wrap with Tzatziki, Feta & Salad

Serves 6 · Cook 35 min

Ingredients

  • 138.8g (¾ cup) basmati rice
  • 1 ½ pkgs crumbled feta cheese
  • 1 ½ English cucumbers
  • 3 cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
  • 9g (3 cloves) garlic
  • 90ml (6 ⅛ tbsp) Italian salad dressing
  • 6 large flour tortillas
  • 1 ½ pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
  • 369g (3) tomatoes
  • 355ml (1 ½ cups) tzatziki sauce
  • 3.1g (1 ½ tsp) cumin, ground
  • 6g (1 tsp) salt
  • 2.3g (¾ tsp) turmeric, ground
  • 355ml (1 ½ cup) water

Instructions

  1. Drain and rinse chickpeas; place in a medium saucepan.

    3 cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

  2. Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the pan with the chickpeas. Add water and spices; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

    138.8g (¾ cup) basmati rice · 355ml (1 ½ cup) water · 3.1g (1 ½ tsp) cumin, ground · 6g (1 tsp) salt · 2.3g (¾ tsp) turmeric, ground

  3. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes.
  4. Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

    369g (3) tomatoes · 1 ½ English cucumbers · 1 ½ pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

  5. Medium dice tomatoes; trim and medium dice cucumbers. Place both in a large bowl and set aside.
  6. Peel and mince garlic. When the chickpea-rice mixture is done, remove from heat, add the garlic, then stir to combine.

    9g (3 cloves) garlic

  7. Add mixed greens, feta, and dressing to the bowl with the tomato and cucumber; toss to combine the salad.

    1 ½ pkgs crumbled feta cheese · 79.8ml (⅓ cup) italian salad dressing

  8. To assemble the wraps, place tortillas on a flat surface and spread each with an even layer of tzatziki. Divide warm chickpea-rice mixture between tortillas, top with a small portion of salad (reserving the rest for serving), and roll tightly to close.

    6 large flour tortillas · 355ml (1 ½ cups) tzatziki sauce

  9. Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!

Chicken Kebabs with Greek Salad & Tzatziki Sauce

Serves 6 · Cook 45 min

Ingredients

  • 680g (1 ½ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless
  • 1 ½ pkgs crumbled feta cheese
  • 1 ½ English cucumbers
  • 27g (9 cloves) garlic
  • 540g (1 ½ pints) grape tomatoes
  • 177ml (¾ cup) Kalamata olives, pitted
  • 87g (1 ½) lemons
  • 367.5g (1 ½ cups) plain Greek yogurt
  • 1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
  • 5.4g (2 ¼ tsp) black pepper, divided
  • 133ml (9 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil
  • 1.5g (1 ½ tsp) oregano, dried
  • 44ml (3 tbsp) red wine vinegar
  • 13.5g (2 ¼ tsp) salt, divided

Instructions

  1. Peel and mince the garlic.

    18g (6 cloves) garlic

  2. In a small bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.

    juice of ¾ lemon · 133ml (9 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil · 44ml (3 tbsp) red wine vinegar · 1.5g (1 ½ tsp) oregano · 9g (1 ½ tsp) salt · 3.6g (1 ½ tsp) black pepper

  3. Cube the chicken and transfer to a medium bowl. Pour half of the dressing over top (save the rest for the salad) and toss to coat.

    680g (1 ½ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless

  4. Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
  5. Thread the chicken onto 6 skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
  6. Add the chicken to the grill or skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
  7. Wash and dry the fresh produce.

    1 ½ head romaine lettuce · 1 ½ English cucumber · 540g (1 ½ pint) grape tomatoes

  8. Finely dice ¼ of the cucumber. Peel and mince the remaining garlic. In a small bowl, prepare the tzatziki sauce by mixing together the cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, and salt.

    9g (3 cloves) garlic · juice of ¾ lemon · 367.5g (1 ½ cup) plain Greek yogurt · 4.5g (¾ tsp) salt · 1.8g (¾ tsp) black pepper

  9. Halve the lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips; transfer to a salad bowl. Quarter the remaining cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into chunks; add to the bowl. Halve the tomatoes; add to the bowl.
  10. Add the olives, feta, and reserved dressing to the salad and toss.

    177ml (¾ cup) Kalamata olives, pitted · 1 ½ pkg crumbled feta cheese

  11. To serve, place salad on a plate and add a chicken skewer on top. Serve with tzatziki sauce and enjoy!

White Bean Pasta Salad with Tomato, Cucumber, Avocado & Pine Nuts

Serves 6 · Cook 40 min

Ingredients

  • 225g (1 ½) avocados
  • 3 cans cannellini (white kidney) beans
  • 1 ½ English cucumbers
  • 540g (1 ½ pints) grape tomatoes
  • 87g (1 ½) lemons
  • 79.8ml (⅓ cup) pine nuts
  • 425g (4 ¼ cup) rotini pasta
  • 80g (2) shallots
  • 1.1g (1 ½ tsp) basil, dried
  • 1.2g (½ tsp) black pepper
  • 79.8ml (⅓ cup) mayonnaise
  • 18g (1 tbsp) salt, divided

Instructions

  1. Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.

    9g (1 ½ tsp) salt · 425g (4 ¼ cup) rotini pasta

  2. Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

    87g (1 ½) lemons · 540g (1 ½ pints) grape tomatoes · 1 ½ English cucumbers · 225g (1 ½) avocados

  3. Juice lemons into a large bowl.
  4. Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the lemon juice.

    80g (2) shallots

  5. Add mayo and spices to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.

    79.8ml (⅓ cup) mayonnaise · 1.1g (1 ½ tsp) basil, dried · 9g (1 ½ tsp) salt · 1.2g (½ tsp) black pepper

  6. Quarter tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
  7. Trim and small dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
  8. Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
  9. Drain and rinse beans, then add to the bowl.

    3 cans cannellini (white kidney) beans

  10. Add cooked pasta and pine nuts to the bowl, then stir to combine the pasta salad.

    79.8ml (⅓ cup) pine nuts

  11. To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

Curried Quinoa Salad with Chickpeas, Apples & Feta

Serves 4 · Cook 30 min

Ingredients

  • 2 sticks celery
  • 473ml (2 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
  • 1 pkg crumbled feta cheese
  • 364g (2) Gala apples
  • 2 cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
  • 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
  • 58g (1) lemon
  • 170g (1 cup) quinoa
  • 0.6g (¼ tsp) black pepper
  • 2.1g (1 tsp) curry powder
  • 44ml (3 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil
  • 7.1g (1 tsp) honey
  • 3g (½ tsp) salt

Instructions

  1. In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa and broth; bring to a boil over high heat.

    170g (1 cup) quinoa · 473ml (2 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

  2. Wash and dry the fresh produce.

    364g (2) Gala apples · 2 sticks celery · 58g (1) lemon · 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

  3. Drain and rinse the chickpeas; set aside to drain further.

    2 cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

  4. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Once done, remove the quinoa from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
  5. Quarter the apples lengthwise, then cut out the core and stem from each section; medium dice the apples into ½-inch cubes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
  6. Trim off and discard the ends of the celery; medium dice the celery into ½-inch pieces and add to the salad bowl.
  7. Using a knife, shave the parsley leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
  8. Transfer the feta to a small bowl.

    1 pkg crumbled feta cheese

  9. Juice the lemon into a small bowl.
  10. To the lemon juice, add olive oil, honey, curry powder, salt, and pepper; whisk together.

    44ml (3 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil · 7.1g (1 tsp) honey · 2.1g (1 tsp) curry powder · 3g (½ tsp) salt · 0.6g (¼ tsp) black pepper

  11. Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
  12. Add the chickpeas and quinoa to the salad bowl, then pour the dressing overtop and toss to combine.
  13. To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with the feta. Enjoy!

Black Bean & Veggie Quesadillas with Tomato & Avocado Salsa

Serves 6 · Cook 50 min

Ingredients

  • 450g (3) avocados
  • 1 ½ cans black beans
  • 1 ½ blocks cheddar cheese
  • 1 ½ small bunches cilantro
  • 3 jalapeño peppers
  • 6 large flour tortillas
  • 66g (1 ½) limes
  • 357g (3) red bell peppers
  • 1 ½ medium red onions
  • 738g (6) tomatoes
  • 1.8g (¾ tsp) black pepper, divided
  • 4.1g (1 ½ tsp) chili powder
  • 3.1g (1 ½ tsp) cumin, ground
  • 81ml (5 ½ tbsp) extra virgin olive oil, divided
  • 9g (1 ½ tsp) salt, divided

Instructions

  1. Wash and dry tomatoes, jalapeños, and cilantro.

    738g (6) tomatoes · 3 jalapeño peppers · 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

  2. Medium dice and transfer tomatoes to a large bowl. Seed, mince, and add ½ of the jalapeños to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Halve and pit avocados; scoop out the flesh, medium dice, and add to bowl. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling). Peel, small dice onions, and add ½ to bowl (save the rest for the quesadilla filling).

    450g (3) avocados · 1 ½ medium red onion

  3. Drizzle ingredients in bowl with olive oil and lime juice; season with salt and pepper. Mix to combine and set aside.

    15ml (3 tsp) extra virgin olive oil · juice of 1 ½ limes · 4.5g (¾ tsp) salt · 1g (⅜ tsp) black pepper

  4. Heat a skillet over medium heat.
  5. Wash, seed, and small dice bell peppers.

    357g (3) red bell peppers

  6. Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add remaining onion, jalapeño, and bell pepper. Stirring frequently, cook until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.

    44ml (3 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil

  7. Drain and rinse beans.

    1 ½ cans black beans

  8. Add beans and remaining cilantro to skillet. Then season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.

    4.1g (1 ½ tsp) chili powder · 3.1g (1 ½ tsp) cumin · 4.5g (¾ tsp) salt · 1g (⅜ tsp) black pepper

  9. Grate 3 cups of cheddar.

    1 ½ block cheddar cheese

  10. Wash and dry skillet. Heat over medium heat.
  11. Place tortillas on a flat surface. Layer one half of each tortilla with ⅛ of the cheese, ¼ of the bean mixture, and another ⅛ of the cheese. Fold tortillas over to close.

    6 large (burrito size) flour tortillas

  12. Coat skillet with oil. Place 2 of the quesadillas in the skillet, straight edges next to each other. Cook until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted, 2-3 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining quesadillas.

    22ml (1 ½ tbsp) extra virgin olive oil

  13. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into wedges.
  14. To serve, place quesadilla on a plate and serve with salsa. Enjoy!

Sweet & Sour Thai Chicken Vegetable Soup

Serves 6 · Cook 50 min

Ingredients

  • 3 medium carrots
  • 1kg (2 ¼ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless
  • 710ml (3 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
  • 1 ½ small bunches cilantro
  • 1 ½ cans coconut milk
  • 18g (6 cloves) garlic
  • 3 pieces ginger root
  • 132g (3) limes
  • 179g (1 ½) orange bell peppers
  • 54g (3) caps portobello mushrooms
  • 3 pinch crushed red pepper
  • 44ml (3 tbsp) fish sauce
  • 63.8g (3 tbsp) honey
  • 22ml (1 ½ tbsp) rice vinegar
  • 9.1g (1 tbsp) turmeric, ground
  • 59ml (¼ cup) virgin coconut oil

Instructions

  1. Wash and dry the fresh produce.

    3 pieces ginger root · 3 medium carrots · 179g (1 ½) orange bell peppers · 54g (3) caps portobello mushrooms · 132g (3) limes · 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

  2. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces, set aside.

    1kg (2 ¼ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless

  3. Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.

    59ml (¼ cup) virgin coconut oil

  4. Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Add both to the pot.

    18g (6 cloves) garlic

  5. Add to the pot turmeric and crushed red pepper, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

    9.1g (1 tbsp) turmeric · 3 pinch crushed red pepper

  6. Add chicken pieces to pot, stirring occasionally.
  7. Peel and thinly slice carrots on the bias. Cut the bell pepper lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane then slice thinly. Add veggies to the pot.
  8. Remove the stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills with a spoon, making sure not to damage the rim of the mushrooms. Cut cap in half, thinly slice and add to the pot.
  9. Cook chicken and vegetables, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
  10. Add broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, honey, and vinegar and stir to combine.

    710ml (3 cup) chicken or vegetable broth · 1 ½ cans coconut milk · 44ml (3 tbsp) fish sauce · 63.8g (3 tbsp) honey · 22ml (1 ½ tbsp) rice vinegar

  11. Bring soup to boil and then reduce heat to low. Simmer for 8-10 minutes, allowing the chicken to cook fully and flavors to blend.
  12. Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
  13. Juice the lime and add to the pot right before serving, stir to combine.
  14. To serve, divide soup between bowls and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!

Tomato-Spinach Orzo with Ground Turkey, Parmesan & Parsley

Serves 6 · Cook 35 min

Ingredients

  • 3 pkgs baby spinach
  • 710ml (3 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
  • 1kg (2 ¼ lb) ground turkey
  • 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
  • 425g (4 ¼ cup) orzo pasta
  • 85g (¾ cup) Parmesan cheese
  • ½ medium red onion
  • 3 cans tomato sauce
  • 1.8g (¾ tsp) black pepper
  • 4ml (¾ tsp) crushed red pepper
  • 30ml (2 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil
  • 4.7g (1 ½ tsp) garlic powder
  • 2.5g (1 tbsp) Italian seasoning
  • 9g (1 ½ tsp) salt

Instructions

  1. Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
  2. While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and mince onion.

    ½ medium red onion

  3. Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, turkey, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.

    30ml (2 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil · 1kg (2 ¼ lb) ground turkey · 2.5g (1 tbsp) Italian seasoning · 4.7g (1 ½ tsp) garlic powder · 9g (1 ½ tsp) salt · 1.8g (¾ tsp) black pepper · 4ml (¾ tsp) crushed red pepper

  4. Add broth, tomato sauce, and orzo to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.

    710ml (3 cup) chicken or vegetable broth · 3 cans tomato sauce · 425g (4 ¼ cup) orzo pasta

  5. Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in a small bowl.

    85g (¾ cup) Parmesan cheese

  6. Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan, stir to combine, and set aside.

    1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

  7. Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).

    3 pkgs baby spinach

  8. When the orzo is done, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
  9. Add half of the Parmesan-parsley mixture to the pot and stir to combine. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining Parmesan mixture for serving.)
  10. To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls; top with reserved Parmesan mixture. Enjoy!

Chicken, Bell Pepper & Cashew Stir-Fry over Rice

  • 102.8g (¾ cup) cashews, roasted unsalted
  • 1.4kg (3 lb) chicken thighs, boneless skinless

  • 1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
  • 20.6g (1 ½ tbsp) brown sugar
  • 16g (2 tbsp) cornstarch
  • 22ml (1 ½ tbsp) rice vinegar
  • 177ml (¾ cup) soy sauce
  • 59ml (4 tbsp) toasted sesame oil, divided
  • 710ml (3 cup) water

Instructions

  1. Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

    277.5g (1 ½ cups) basmati rice · 710ml (3 cup) water

  2. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
  3. Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

    3 pieces ginger root · 714g (6) green bell peppers · 1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)

Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole

Serves 6 · Cook 50 min

Ingredients

  • 450g (3) avocados
  • 680g (1 ½ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless
  • 1 ½ small bunches cilantro
  • 18g (6 cloves) garlic
  • 132g (3) limes
  • 357g (3) red bell peppers
  • 1 ½ medium red onions
  • 12 small flour tortillas
  • 357g (3) yellow bell peppers
  • 2.7g (1 ⅛ tsp) black pepper, divided
  • 4.1g (1 ½ tsp) chili powder
  • 3.1g (1 ½ tsp) cumin, ground
  • 10.6g (1 ⅞ tsp) salt, divided
  • 67ml (4 ½ tbsp) virgin coconut oil, divided

Instructions

  1. Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.

    357g (3) red bell peppers · 357g (3) yellow bell peppers

  2. Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.

    1 ½ medium red onion · 18g (6 cloves) garlic

  3. Halve avocados and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.

    450g (3) avocados

  4. Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.

    1 ½ small bunches cilantro

  5. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
  6. Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.

    juice of 1 ½ limes · 4.5g (¾ tsp) salt · 1g (⅜ tsp) black pepper

  7. Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.

    680g (1 ½ lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless · 2.6g (⅜ tsp) salt · 1g (⅜ tsp) black pepper

Old-Fashioned Beef Stew

Serves 4

Ingredients

  • 31.3g (¼ cup) all-purpose flour
  • 1ml (¼ teaspoon) freshly ground pepper
  • 454g (1 pound) beef stewing meat, trimmed and cut into inch cubes
  • 25ml (5 teaspoons) vegetable oil
  • 30ml (2 tablespoons) red wine vinegar
  • 237ml (1 cup) red wine
  • 828ml (3 ½ cups) beef broth, homemade or low-sodium canned
  • 2 bay leaves
  • 1 medium onion, peeled and chopped
  • 5 medium carrots, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch rounds
  • 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
  • 12g (2 teaspoons) salt

Instructions

  1. Combine the flour and pepper in a bowl, add the beef and toss to coat well. Heat 3 teaspoons of the oil in a large pot . Add the beef a few pieces at a time; do not overcrowd. Cook, turning the pieces until beef is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch; add more oil as needed between batches.
  2. Remove the beef from the pot and add the vinegar and wine. Cook over medium-high heat, scraping the pan with a wooden spoon to loosen any browned bits. Add the beef, beef broth and bay leaves. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a slow simmer.
  3. Cover and cook, skimming broth from time to time, until the beef is tender, about 1 1/2 hours. Add the onions and carrots and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Add the potatoes and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes more. Add broth or water if the stew is dry. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Ladle among 4 bowls and serve.

Delicata Squash & Tofu Curry

Serves 4

Ingredients

  • 12.5g (2 tablespoons) curry powder, preferably Madras
  • 3g (½ teaspoon) salt
  • 1ml (¼ teaspoon) freshly ground pepper
  • 1 14-ounce package extra-firm or firm water-packed tofu
  • 20ml (4 teaspoons) canola oil, divided
  • 1 large delicata squash (about 1 pound), halved, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes
  • 1 medium onion, halved and sliced
  • 10ml (2 teaspoons) grated fresh ginger
  • 1 14-ounce can “lite” coconut milk
  • 4.6g (1 teaspoon) light brown sugar
  • 536g (8 cups) coarsely chopped kale or chard, tough stems removed
  • 15ml (1 tablespoon) lime juice, plus more to taste

Instructions

  1. Combine curry powder, salt and pepper in a small bowl. Blot tofu dry with a paper towel and cut into 1-inch cubes; toss the tofu in a medium bowl with 1 teaspoon of the spice mixture.
  2. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu and cook, stirring every 2 minutes, until browned, 6 to 8 minutes total. Transfer to a plate.
  3. Heat the remaining 2 teaspoons oil over medium-high heat.
  4. Add squash, onion, ginger and the remaining spice mixture; cook, stirring, until the vegetables are lightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes.
  5. Add coconut milk and brown sugar; bring to a boil.
  6. Add half the kale (or chard) and cook, stirring, until slightly wilted, about 1 minute.
  7. Stir in the rest of the greens and cook, stirring, for 1 minute.
  8. Return the tofu to the pan, cover and cook, stirring once or twice, until the squash and greens are tender, 3 to 5 minutes more.
  9. Remove from the heat and stir in lime juice.

Sweet Potato Lentil Stew

Ingredients

  • 384g (2 cups) organic green or brown lentils
  • 1 large sweet potato (cut into small cubes)
  • 75g (½) yellow onion
  • 1 large carrot (-diced)
  • 1 rib celery (-diced)
  • 15g (5 cloves) garlic (-minced)
  • 2.1L (9 cups) water or veggie stock (low sodium)
  • 2.1g (1 tsp) cumin
  • 1.8g (1 tsp) ground coriander
  • 4.6g (2 tsp) smoked paprika (sweet or hot)
  • 4.8g (2 tsp) onion powder
  • 1.5g (½ tsp) turmeric
  • 1 leaf bay
  • 30ml (2 tbsp) red wine vinegar or fresh lime
  • 1 pinch red chili flakes (to taste)
  • 90g (3 cups) kale or baby spinach
  • sea salt + black pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add a splash of water and saute the diced onion with a pinch of sea salt until translucent. Stir in the carrot and celery cook a few more minutes until softened.
  2. Add the garlic and give it a good stir before adding the spices: cumin, smoked paprika, coriander, onion powder, turmeric and bay leaf.
  3. Meanwhile rinse the lentils then add them into the pot. Cover with the veggie stock or water and bring to a simmer. Cook covered on low flame for 30 minutes.
  4. Taste and adjust seasonings with sea salt and black paper then add the sweet potatoes to the stew. Cook another 10 to 15 minutes until softened. Discard bay leaf.
  5. Ladle about 1/3 of the stew into&nbsp; a blender and puree until smooth. Add it back into the pot with the stew and stir to combine. If the stew is too thick for your liking just add more water or veggie stock to stretch it out a bit. Remember to adjust seasonings.
  6. Add the kale or spinach and cook just a couple of minutes until wilted. Remove from heat and stir in some red wine vinegar or a hit of lime to balance out the flavors. Serve hot with spicy chili flakes on top. Note: If you want to turn it into more of a soup rather than a stew, simply add more veggie stock and adjust seasonings.
  7. Crock Pot Method: Add all the ingredients to your crock pot and cook on high for 6 hours or on low for 8 hours. Discard bay leaf, remove about 1/3 of the soup and carefully transfer to a powerful blender. Puree until smooth and add back into the stew. Taste and adjust seasonings with sea salt and black pepper.

  7. Remove portobello mushroom stems and scrape out the gills. Cut mushroom caps in half and then crosswise into thin strips. Add to the pot with the broth.
  8. Thinly slice white mushrooms and add to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a boil over high heat.
  9. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.

    79.8ml (⅓ cup) water · 43g (⅓ cup) cornstarch

  10. Once the broth comes to a boil, add the cornstarch slurry in a steady stream while stirring quickly. Return soup to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to medium-low; let simmer until soup thickens slightly and mushrooms begin to soften, about 3 minutes.
  11. Slice tofu into thin strips.
  12. Whisk eggs and salt together in a medium bowl. Slowly pour the egg mixture into the soup, while gently stirring, to separate into strands.

    300g (6) eggs · 1.5g (¼ tsp) salt

  13. Add tofu to the soup and stir to combine; cover and remove from heat.
  14. Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; stir half of the green onions into the soup (reserving the rest for garnish).
  15. To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved green onions. Enjoy!

Spicy Peanut Tofu Bowl with Kale & Savory Sesame Rice

Serves 4 · Cook 35 min

Ingredients

  • 2 medium carrots
  • 2 pkg extra firm tofu
  • 6g (2 cloves) garlic
  • 2 pieces ginger root
  • 185g (1 cup) jasmine rice
  • 2 bunches kale
  • 15ml (1 tbsp) chili-garlic sauce
  • 64.5g (¼ cup) natural peanut butter
  • 39ml (2 ⅔ tbsp) pure maple syrup, divided
  • 18g (2 tbsp) sesame seeds
  • 69ml (4 ⅔ tbsp) soy sauce, divided
  • 74ml (5 tbsp) toasted sesame oil, divided
  • 640.2ml (2 ⅔ cup) water, divided

Instructions

  1. Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place side by side on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

    2 pkg extra firm tofu

  2. Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

    185g (1 cup) jasmine rice · 473ml (2 cup) water

  3. Peel and mince the garlic. In a medium bowl, combine garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, and maple syrup to make a marinade for the tofu.

    6g (2 cloves) garlic · 30ml (2 tbsp) toasted sesame oil · 59ml (¼ cup) soy sauce · 30ml (2 tbsp) pure maple syrup

  4. Once the liquid with the rice comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
  5. Meanwhile, cut the tofu planks in half and then cut each half into 4 triangles. Place tofu in the bowl with the marinade and gently toss until well coated. Set aside.
  6. Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a salad bowl.

    2 bunches kale

  7. Wash, trim, and peel the carrots; coarsely grate and set aside.

    2 medium carrots

  8. Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
  9. Wash, peel, and mince or grate the ginger.

    2 pieces ginger root

  10. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and the marinade. Cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.

    30ml (2 tbsp) toasted sesame oil

  11. Meanwhile, prepare the peanut sauce by whisking together ginger, peanut butter, chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, maple syrup, and hot water in a small bowl.

    64.5g (¼ cup) natural peanut butter · 15ml (1 tbsp) chili-garlic sauce · 10ml (2 tsp) soy sauce · 10ml (2 tsp) pure maple syrup · 44ml (3 tbsp) water

  12. Once the tofu is cooked, transfer to a plate, returning the skillet to the heat. Add kale and water to the skillet and cover with a lid. Allow to steam for 1 minute covered then uncover, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute more.

    118ml (½ cup) water

  13. Uncover the rice, fluff with a fork, and add sesame oil. Fold the oil into the rice.

    15ml (1 tbsp) toasted sesame oil

  14. To serve, divide rice between bowls, top with tofu, grated carrot, and kale; drizzle with peanut sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!

    18g (2 tbsp) sesame seeds
